description: A collection of repository interfaces and abstractions for the MKS system, providing contracts for read, write, and bulk operations with expression-based queries.
releaseNotes:
Version 3.1.9: Version alignment with MKS.CQRS.EntityFrameworkCore 3.1.9 (BeginTransactionQuery DI registration fix).
       Version 3.1.8: Bug fix release - Fixed parameter placeholders in ExecuteUpdate/ExecuteDelete on EF Core 3.1 (ORA-00904 "P0": invalid identifier introduced in 3.1.7).
       Version 3.1.7: Bug fix release - Fixed SQL parameter types in ExecuteUpdate/ExecuteDelete (IsUnicode(false) is respected) and strict predicate parsing.
       Version 3.1.6: Performance improvement - Added AsNoTracking() to specification-based read methods for better performance.
       Version 3.1.5: Bug fix release - Fixed DBNull mapping issue in SQL parameters.
       Version 3.1.4: Bug fix release - Fixed parameter evaluation in UpdateFromQueryCommand for closure variables (e.g., test.Name).
       Version 3.1.3: Bug fix release - Enhanced ValueConverter support for enum conversions with Description attributes.
       Version 3.1.2: Bug fix release - Fixed ValueConverter support in ExecuteUpdate and ExecuteDelete operations.
       Version 3.1.0: Updated documentation to reflect removal of Z.EntityFramework.Plus dependency.
       - Updated XML documentation comments to remove Z.EntityFramework.Plus references
       - All bulk operations now use custom implementations
       Version 3.0.0: Migrated to .NET Standard 2.0 for maximum compatibility.
       Removed Specification-based overloads for cleaner API surface.
       All methods now use expression-based queries (Expression<Func<TEntity, bool>>).
       Breaking change: Removed ISpecification-based method overloads.
       Version 9.3.0: Added transaction support across repository operations.
       New: ITransactionScope interface for managing database transactions across multiple operations.
       All repository methods now support optional transaction scope parameter for atomic multi-operation scenarios.
       Enhanced flexibility for complex business operations requiring transactional consistency.
title: MKS.RepositoryAbstractions
